title: Verify: characterClick event type unit tests
summary: Unit-test delivery of the typed characterClick event on the bus.
description: Add tests to the existing phaserEvents suite proving characterClick delivery and isolation from objectClick.
acceptance_criteria: Given a characterClick handler, When emitted with { id: 'boy' }, Then it is called once with that payload.
Given an objectClick handler, When characterClick is emitted, Then the objectClick handler is not called.

steps.symbol: new: it('delivers characterClick payload once and not to objectClick handlers')
steps.action: Add a test subscribing vi.fn() handlers to phaserToReact 'characterClick' and 'objectClick', emit characterClick with { id: 'boy' }, assert characterClick handler called once with { id: 'boy' } and objectClick handler not called; then unsubscribe and call phaserToReact.clear().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts
steps.expected: phaserEvents suite passes including the new characterClick test.
